nl: Rename the method area of the class Circle to surface, together with its calls on Circle objects. The method area of Square and its calls stay unchanged.

entries.content_utf8:
from app.model import Circle, Square


def run():
    circle = Circle()
    square = Square()
    return [circle.area(), square.area()]

app/main.py.text:
from app.model import Circle, Square


def run():
    circle = Circle()
    square = Square()
    return [circle.surface(), square.area()]

reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('app/model.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('class Circle:\n    def area(self):') == 1, 'app/model.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('class Circle:\n    def area(self):', 'class Circle:\n    def surface(self):').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('app/main.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('circle.area()') == 1, 'app/main.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('circle.area()', 'circle.surface()').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('tests/test_model.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('Circle().area()') == 1, 'tests/test_model.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('Circle().area()', 'Circle().surface()').encode())
EOF
